Unlocking the Secrets of Movement for Better Health

The Future of Health Starts with How You Move

“Empowering healthcare and research with non-invasive, scalable solutions that improve outcomes and reduce costs.”

Our Vision

We’re transforming healthcare by using movement as a universal biomarker for health. By leveraging the world’s largest movement database, correlated with medical records and biomarkers, we’re creating AI-driven tools that predict and prevent diseases through something as simple as video. Our goal? To enable instant, non-invasive health screening—accessible from home.

Why Movement?

Traditional diagnostics only capture static snapshots of health. Movement, however, is dynamic, evolving, and reflects the interconnected systems of the body.

​

Newton Tech’s Movement Signatures technology decodes the story embedded in motion, enabling:

​

  • More frequent and accessible health insights.

  • Cost-effective, non-invasive screening.

  • Scalable solutions for healthcare and research.

Accomplishments That Matter

Deployment in Large Cohort Studies:
With over 2,000 labeled subjects, including disease, genome, and movement data, we empower researchers to train models that detect medical conditions based on movement biomarkers.
Mobi Success:
Revolutionizing physical therapy through our FDA-registered medical device that has treated patients with stroke, brain cancer, and many other pathologies.
Global Partnerships:
